Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614257. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Join activities to assays and filter by assay CHEMBL1614257. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
